evals.prompt:
Convert this Web Awesome HTML to Kigumi Vue:
<wa-input label="Name" required></wa-input>
<wa-input label="Email" type="email" required></wa-input>
<wa-button variant="brand" type="submit">Submit</wa-button>
evals.expected_output: Vue SFC with <script setup>, proper event handling, NO v-model on Kigumi components.
expectations: Uses @input event handler (not v-model) for Input components
Uses class (not className) on all elements

evals.prompt: Build a Dialog with a form inside it in Vue using Kigumi components. The dialog should have Save and Cancel buttons in the footer.
evals.expected_output: Vue SFC with controlled open state via :open and @wa-hide, proper slot usage for footer.
expectations: Has slot='footer' as a direct child of Dialog (not nested inside form)
Uses ref() from vue for state management

evals.prompt: What events does the Select component emit in Vue? I need to handle selection changes.
evals.expected_output: Lists both native events (@input, @change) and custom events (@wa-show, @wa-hide, etc.) with correct Vue syntax.
expectations: Lists @change as a native Event (not CustomEvent)
Lists @wa-show and @wa-hide as custom overlay events
Uses @ prefix for Vue event syntax (not on* React syntax)
Shows how to access the selected value from the event
